declared: 2026-11-25, before any measurement on the PC (i9-14900). Must not be edited after v10 results exist; a change requires a new version file and re-labelling every claim.

hardware_factor.definition: k_hw from benchmarks/hardware_calibration.py on the SAME machine and measurement CPU: median over the 7 Table II environments x (mean, median, p75) of local/paper VAMP geometric RRTConnect time (paper Table II 'RRTConnect time' of the baseline). Paper times are multiplied by k_hw before comparison. If k_hw is outside [0.25, 4] time claims are labelled HARDWARE_UNCALIBRATED.

time_band.statistic: mean and median of per-attempt total planning time (search + Alg. 4), each attempt summarised by the median of its k timing repeats; cold first repeat reported separately
time_band.reproduced_if: 1/3 <= local / (k_hw * paper) <= 3 for the mean (and for the median where the paper reports it)
time_band.faster_label: DIFFERENT_FASTER when the ratio < 1/3: requires an explanation (protocol difference, easier problem) and is never counted as reproduced

validity.denominator: all attempts (failures, timeouts and invalid returns stay in the denominator)
validity.valid_means: passes the independent check on the ORIGINAL model: original geometry, original state/control limits (norms where the paper writes norms), start state, goal region; Panda: dense VAMP check and URDF/NumPy check
validity.reproduced_requires: valid fraction >= 0.95 (Table I, Table II per environment); Wilson 95% interval reported
validity.reduced_order_aerial: order-2 aerial trajectories have attitude/body-rate jumps at joins; they are reported under the label REDUCED_ORDER_PROTOCOL (paper Sec. V-C1 practice) and can never support an 'original-model valid' claim. Original-model validity for aerial robots is claimed only from order-4 runs that pass the interval oracle.

protocol_labels.unicycle_faithful: primary: flat unicycle (Example 2), curved edges, |v|<=1 and |omega|<=1.5 checked along edges
protocol_labels.unicycle_stop_turn: variant only: rest nodes, straight edges, in-place turns; never counted as reproducing Table I
protocol_labels.panda_rest: reconstructed sampler: all nodes at rest
protocol_labels.panda_full_state: Alg. 2 literal: flat state (q, qdot) sampled within limits
protocol_labels.note: Panda rest and full-state are both reported; neither is tuned toward paper numbers.

measurement_control.controlled_requires: preflight passed on the measurement P-core with idle SMT sibling; fixed-work probe drift before/after the stage <= 10%; source hash unchanged
measurement_control.uncontrolled_label: UNCONTROLLED: values reported, no reproduced/different verdict

uncertainty: cluster bootstrap over (environment, problem) for Table II and over seeds for Table I; 95% percentile intervals on ratios
